messages:
sarah.ng: Kickoff for Triton POC — need to align sample data, redaction, storage & success criteria. They can share up to ~10k rows of de-identified clinical notes but want a Redwood sandbox. Questions: preferred ingestion path (S3 vs direct upload), redaction guidance, evaluation prompts, timeline for a 2-week POC, and any pricing delta for hosted vs dedicated. @mike.wu can you own sandbox provisioning?

mike.wu: I can take this. Will provision sandbox (VPC + S3) today. Quick Q — do they want data in our tenant bucket or their account (we usually recommend customer-managed buckets for compliance)?

sarah.ng: Triton asked for Redwood-managed sandbox to speed things up. Security said client-side redaction + temp creds is acceptable for the demo. They still require VPC peering and a KMS key. I'll share their security contact details after this thread.

provision-bot: Sandbox provisioned: sandbox-triton-1843001234 created in eu-west-1. S3 bucket: s3://redwood-sandbox-triton-1843001234. IAM creds expire in 48h. Console: <https://console.redwood.ai/sandboxes/sandbox-triton-1843001234>

evan.choi: Quick redaction guidance we should send them (keep it simple for the POC). Recommend client-side scrub + server-side checksum. Example Python snippet we send as a starter:

```
# simple PHI scrub (example)
import re
text = re.sub(r'\b(\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})\b', '[SSN]', text)
text = re.sub(r'\b(\d{4} \d{4} \d{4} \d{4})\b', '[CC]', text)
# names/addresses: consider tokenization or mapping to [NAME]/[ADDR]
```

evan.choi: We also offer an optional mapping tool if they want to pseudonymize rather than drop identifiers. For the POC keep it conservative (drop highly sensitive fields).

anna.peralta: Proposed success criteria for the POC: (1) 95th latency <= 350ms for generate endpoints on 512-token prompts; (2) model accuracy: triage classifier recall >= 0.88 on our eval set; (3) redaction false-negative rate <= 1% on the redaction eval set; (4) end-to-end pipeline ingests sample data and produces anonymized outputs within 2 hours after upload.

sarah.ng: Triton emphasized recall over precision — they want missed PHI to be minimal. We'll run two prompt suites: triage-classifier and note-summarizer. @anna.peralta can you prepare prompt templates and the eval harness?

anna.peralta: On it. ETA: EOD tomorrow for prompt templates + pytest-based eval harness + golden files. We'll place artifacts in the sandbox under /eval and include instructions to run locally.

mike.wu: Connectivity/runbook notes (short): 1) Triton creates VPC peering request -> 2) we accept -> 3) add route to 10.42.0.0/16 on both sides -> 4) security group allows 443 from their ENIs. I will draft a step-by-step runbook and the terraform snippet.

sarah.ng: Pricing question from Triton: will the POC incur charges? Answer: hosted sandbox usage is waived up to 100k tokens + 1 GPU-equivalent for 2 weeks. If they request Dedicated reserved capacity for deterministic latency, we need a short-term refundable reservation fee. @mike.wu confirm and I'll include in SOW-lite.

mike.wu: Confirmed — hosted sandbox is complimentary within quotas. Dedicated short-term trial requires a refundable credit (we'll quote separately). I'll put options in the SOW-lite.

sarah.ng: :thumbsup: Next steps: I'll send SOW-lite + security contact list; @anna.peralta will drop prompt/eval artifacts; @mike.wu will finish the network runbook and post creds expiry schedule. Target: sandbox + eval harness ready by EOD Thu, start 2-week POC next Mon. Any blockers?

evan.choi: One potential blocker: Triton's security team asked whether our redaction stack is FIPS-friendly — they mentioned FedRAMP as a potential future requirement. If FedRAMP/FIPS is required we may need to shift to Private deployment (KMS/HSM) which has longer lead times.

sarah.ng: Good catch. I'll confirm with Triton sec now. If FedRAMP is required, we'll flag AE and legal; Private deployment discussion will be escalated.

mike.wu: I'll also include a short note in the runbook for KMS/HSM options in case we need to spin that up later.

sarah.ng: Thanks all — will update after I talk to Triton sec.
